query:
SELECT p.id                AS "project_id!",
               p.code              AS "code!",
               p.name              AS "name!",
               CAST(sum(e.duration_minutes) AS INTEGER) AS "minutes!: i64",
               p.hourly_rate_cents AS "hourly_rate_cents"
        FROM entries e
        JOIN projects p ON p.id = e.project_id
        WHERE p.client_id = ?1
          AND e.started_at >= ?2
          AND e.started_at <  ?3
        GROUP BY p.id
        ORDER BY lower(p.code)
